BL-889 — DEFECT — a test harness invoked without its fixture-root argument silently re-roots at the cwd, scanning live mailboxes and delivering real parcels
What it solves: Specifier probe, 2026-08-14 — the report is accurate and the hazard is
wider than the one file it was found in:
Approval context: New feature draft needs review. The judgement call worth your eye is the scope line: this fixes the SILENT part (a missing root becomes a refusal instead of the cwd) and deliberately does NOT try to detect "you passed a live root on purpose" — an explicit `.` or an explicit live path stays allowed,…
BL-889 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-889" (or "reject BL-889 <reason>") to act.
